header.title: Conference Venue
header.description: The conference will be held at Ajay Binay Institute of Technology, Odisha. It is conveniently located in Kataka, The Silver-City of Odisha, India. Kataka is well connected to other major cities of the country via regular flights and trains. From the station/airport, you can take private cabs or taxis or public transport to the conference venue.
